query.text: 请帮我留意洗衣服时的颜色分类，发现可能串色的混洗情况时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please monitor the color sorting during laundry and warn me if mixing garments could cause color transfer.

annotation.text_zh: 红白衣服混洗容易串色，请分开浸泡。
annotation.text_en: Red and white clothes can bleed, so please soak them separately.

annotation.text_zh: 白衣服已放进红衣盆中，请尽快拿出来。
annotation.text_en: The white clothes are in the red basket, please take them out soon.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
